description: Countermodels, positive statements and lemmas of the falsification program (section 12 of the project brief), one record per listed theorem; helper definitions are omitted. None of these refutes a statement of the IUT papers; every countermodel refutes a simplified abstraction.
classification_scale_note: Section 12 of the project brief distinguishes seven kinds of result; its fifth item reads 'counterexample to an intermediate claim', while the shared working rules list 'counterexample to a simplified abstraction' in that place. Records here use the label 'counterexample to a simplified abstraction'; none is a counterexample to an intermediate claim of the papers, to a faithfully formalized statement of the papers, or a demonstrated contradiction.
